notes: The supplied *their* before *fragrance* is added, since רֵיחַ carries no suffix or other possessive morpheme (rule 18's closing sentence).

פַּגֶּיהָ → *green figs* heads on *figs* under rule 31's tie clause, because the ASV writes a bare *fig* for תְּאֵנָה in this same verse; the competing reading heading on *green* is named in that unit's note. תְּאֵנָה itself heads on *fig*, since no bare *tree* stands in the verse for a word of that class.
Variant WLC.SNG.2.13.v002 is underdetermined and resolved to r00-base; no textual decision is taken here (rule 9).
